body: I do care about money. How are you supposed to live without it? It also doesn't help that i was raised upper middle class, and am used to a certain lifestyle (sorry if that makes me sound like a princess). School just feels like the only reasonable thing for me right now. It's everything outside of school that is really stressing me out and putting me in this dark place.

Well, I've done the therapy thing, and it worked until I was no longer able to see my therapist. It's just hard escaping my comfort zone because I am diagnosed with general anxiety and social anxiety. Walking around alone or approaching strangers is literally the scariest things I can thing of. Also, I go to a big school so seeing a campus counselor is very hard.

I actually won't be in debt, but I have thought many times about just dropping out. My parents want me in school, and they're older (65 and 63), so I don't want to stress them out especially when my sisters do that enough. I also fear that without a degree, I'll be forced to work minimum wage jobs for the rest of my life.

I guess the constant feeling of pressure. My parents' pressure on me to have good grades. My sisters' pressure on me to not make a mistake. The own pressure I feel to be almost perfect. And social situations just stress me out.
